  (1 / 5 * abs (9 + c * a) < 1) ↔ a ∈ Set.Ioo (-14 / c) (-4 / c) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have habs : abs (9 + c * a) < 5 := by
      nlinarith
    rcases abs_lt.mp habs with ⟨hlow, hupp⟩
    constructor
    · apply (div_lt_iff₀ hc.1).2
      nlinarith
    · apply (lt_div_iff₀ hc.1).2
      nlinarith
  · intro ha
    rcases ha with ⟨haL, haU⟩
    have hlow : -14 < c * a := by
      have h := (div_lt_iff₀ hc.1).mp haL
      nlinarith
    have hupp : c * a < -4 := by
      have h := (lt_div_iff₀ hc.1).mp haU
      nlinarith
    have habs : abs (9 + c * a) < 5 := by
      apply abs_lt.mpr
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    nlinarith
